As a truck driver, this is very common. I have always found time to go back and read devotional lessons I missed the day or days before. And I have always been able to do that, especially in book form which is how I have done it in the past. And that’s where my problem lies. I cannot go back and read the devotionals I missed out on the day or days before. I would love for that to be an option. title: TRULY AMAZING RESOURCE
body: I am loving the Aura app! The more I use it, the more I appreciate all of its great features! I start my days with the Daily Devotionals, which are thoughtful, educational (love the explanations of the original words in Hebrew and Greek, as well as the historical and cultural contexts in which they were used), challenging, and uplifting. I’ve used the Prayer Journal to make prayer requests and ask some difficult questions on some very personal and sensitive matters, and the responses with reflections and crafted prayers the Aura app generated have been thoughtful, insightful, rich, and meaningful! They really touched my heart as they got to the root of my concerns and questions, and addressed them in a very compassionate manner while integrating sound biblical principles and applicable Bible verses into its responses. At times, I felt as though the Lord was speaking His heart into mine through these reflections and prayers. Also, the Bible Study aspect of Aura is excellent! It has been the most user-friendly Bible commentary tool I have ever used. I love the “Exegesis” feature that provides historical and cultural contexts of individual verses and passages, along with the ability to highlight, make notes, and ask questions that generate further thoughts and insights. It is now my trusted resource in my daily study of the Bible. There are a number of other useful functions of this app as well, but I won’t get into all of them here as it would take too long. Suffice it to say, there are many more great tools available! The bottom line for me is that Aura with all of its outstanding features and functionality keeps bringing me back to the centrality of Christ in everything! It has become an invaluable companion to me in my desire for continual growth and learning in my relationship with the Lord. I would and will highly recommend Aura to all believers who are committed to drawing closer to our God!

body: I know people say this all the time, but I really never leave reviews! I “happened upon” this app and am so glad I did. Thank You, Lord! Clear and concise, a sound translation of the Word, and, so far, seemingly sound doctrine. It helps me craft prayers for myself and others and guides my Bible study with a laser focus. Thank you so much to the developers for following God’s call in making this app!

title: Great design and meaningful devotions
body: I use the daily devotions. They had a bite sized chunk of verses with reflections on its context, application or lesson. I also appreciate the format of the Bible navigation. The books are color coded by genre (law, prophets, etc.)

title: Truly a Game-Changer for Bible Study & Prayer
body: This app is a must-have for any Christian! Aura has transformed my daily walk with God—its AI-powered Bible insights provide deep verse-by-verse context, making Scripture come alive like never before. The personalized devotionals and prayer reflections help me stay rooted in God’s Word during my personal battles. Unlike other AI apps, Aura is theologically sound and aligned with Reformed doctrine, giving me confidence in every response. Highly recommend for anyone seeking deeper faith and spiritual growth! 🙏✨

title: Best Bible App
body: The best Bible app out there. It’s so helpful with my quiet time with Jesus, for digging deeper in the Word for Bible Studies, and for following along during a Sunday morning sermon.
